summary: Improve plan validation error feedback to break repeated invalid plan loops by exposing the specific rejection reason to the agent.

edits.hypothesis: Exposing the specific validation error (e.g., unregistered tool, invalid args) in the retry prompt allows the agent to correct its plan structure rather than blindly repeating the same invalid JSON, fixing the 'repeated_invalid_plan' failure mode seen in q000012.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: A plain instruction edit in the system prompt is too general; the agent needs immediate, step-specific feedback about why its last action was rejected to adjust its syntax or tool selection.
edits.trigger_condition: When validate_actions raises a ValueError, TypeError, or KeyError during the execution loop.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000012, the agent repeatedly sent valid-looking but structurally rejected plans. With this change, it would receive 'unregistered_tool_or_arguments' or similar specific error, prompting it to check the catalog or switch to answer format. (preservative) Successful tasks like q000003 do not hit this path, so no disruption. (transfer) Generalizes to any task where the agent hallucinates tool names or argument structures.
edits.regression_risk: Minimal; only affects the error message string passed to the model in the retry loop.
edits.mechanism: Exposing the specific validation error (e.g., unregistered tool, invalid args) in the retry prompt allows the agent to correct its plan structure rather than blindly repeating the same invalid JSON, fixing the 'repeated_invalid_plan' failure mode seen in q000012.
